definitions.full: H5001. naam [ נָאַם ] verb denominative utter a prophecy, speak as prophet ; — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural נְאֻם וַיִּנְאֲמוּ Jer 23:31 and they uttered (in the prophetic manner), it as an utterance (of ׳י ); they used the prophetic formula (compare י נְאֻם ׳אֹמְרִים Ezek 13:6-7 ,).
